title: Fix: Shopping checkout UX is confusing
description: CRITICAL UX: The entire shopping checkout experience is very confusing and needs complete overhaul. Issues: 1) Missing checkout button (instructions reference it but doesn't exist), 2) Unclear if quantity can be modified in shopping mode. See Testing-Workflow-Coverage.md Workflow 9.

title: Fix: Label printing screen crashes the app
description: CRITICAL BUG: Loading the label printing screen crashes the whole app. Described as 'our most awesome feature' but completely broken. Major test coverage gap - this wasn't caught in any tests. See Testing-Workflow-Coverage.md Workflow 17.

title: Add prompt for users to rate the app
description: Prompt users to rate the app using SKStoreReviewController. Show the prompt after the user has added their 5th inventory item (first time only). Use AppStorage to track whether the prompt has been shown.

title: Fix: Notes not saved when adding inventory item
description: CRITICAL BUG: AddInventoryItemView collects notes in the form but AddInventoryItemViewModel.save() never calls UserNotesRepository to persist them. The notes field exists and collects input but is never used. Fix: After creating inventory record, save notes via UserNotesRepository.createNotes() or updateNotes(). See Testing-Workflow-Coverage.md Workflow 2 for details.

title: Implement Storage Location system (move/consume tracking)
description: Major feature: StorageLocation entity needs date_added, date_modified, containerCount fields. Need new InventoryMoveRecord and InventoryConsumptionRecord entities. See Storage-Location-Implementation-Plan.md and Storage-Location-System-Design.md for full spec. Enables tracking where inventory is stored, when it was added, and audit logs for moves/consumption.

title: Fix: COE filter in Settings doesn't work
description: COE filter in Settings is broken/non-functional. Users cannot filter catalog by COE rating (90, 96, 104) via Settings. Feature flag is enabled (coeGlassFilter = true) but the filter doesn't work. See Testing-Workflow-Coverage.md.
